vocabulary.meaning_en: sitting in a public place and watching the people who pass by
vocabulary.meaning_ar: مراقبة الناس (الجلوس في مكان عام ومشاهدة المارّة)
vocabulary.example: We sat in the park and enjoyed some people-watching.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the meal you eat in the middle of the day
vocabulary.example: I eat lunch at one o'clock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not in a building; in the open air
vocabulary.example: The children are playing outside.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to walk past someone or something
vocabulary.example: Many students walk by the library every morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not the same
vocabulary.example: My two brothers are very different.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not different; alike
vocabulary.example: We have the same bag!

vocabulary.meaning_en: to go back to a place
vocabulary.note_ar: نقول return to work ولا نقول return back
vocabulary.note_en: Say return to work, not return back.
vocabulary.example: I return home at six o'clock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to come and be with other people
vocabulary.example: Come and join us for tea!

vocabulary.meaning_en: a polite way to say 'sit down'
vocabulary.example: Please have a seat. The doctor is coming.

vocabulary.meaning_en: enjoyable; something you like doing
vocabulary.note_ar: لا تخلط بين fun (ممتع) و funny (مضحك)
vocabulary.note_en: Do not mix up fun (enjoyable) and funny (makes you laugh).
vocabulary.example: Playing football with friends is fun.

vocabulary.meaning_en: higher than most people
vocabulary.note_en: For people use tall, not long.
vocabulary.example: My father is very tall.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not tall; not long
vocabulary.example: My grandmother is short.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the parts of the face you see with
vocabulary.example: She has green eyes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the color of coffee or wood
vocabulary.example: He has brown eyes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the color of the sky on a sunny day
vocabulary.example: The baby has blue eyes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the outside covering of the body
vocabulary.example: The sun is strong. Protect your skin.

vocabulary.meaning_en: pale, not dark (for colors, skin and hair)
vocabulary.example: She has light hair.

vocabulary.meaning_en: deep in color, not light
vocabulary.example: He has dark hair and dark eyes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: what grows on your head
vocabulary.note_ar: شعر الرأس اسم غير معدود: لا نقول hairs
vocabulary.note_en: Hair on the head is uncountable: not hairs.
vocabulary.example: My sister has long hair.

vocabulary.meaning_en: with no curves (for hair: not curly)
vocabulary.example: Ashley has straight hair.

vocabulary.meaning_en: with many small curves (for hair)
vocabulary.example: The little boy has curly hair.

vocabulary.meaning_en: two pieces of glass in a frame that help you see
vocabulary.example: My teacher wears glasses.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have clothes or glasses on your body
vocabulary.example: I wear a jacket in winter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a warm piece of clothing for the top of the body
vocabulary.note_en: In the UK it is also called a jumper.
vocabulary.example: It is cold. Wear your sweater.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to go where people cannot see you
vocabulary.example: The cat likes to hide under the bed.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long seat for two or more people, often in a park
vocabulary.example: Let's sit on that bench.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move or do things quickly
vocabulary.note_ar: No need to hurry = لا داعي للعجلة
vocabulary.note_en: No need to hurry = you have time.
vocabulary.example: Hurry! The bus is here.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to not remember
vocabulary.example: Don't forget your keys.

fine_lines.title: have vs has
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نصف شكل الشخص بالفعل have/has. نستخدم has مع he و she و it واسم مفرد. ونستخدم have مع I و you و we و they.
fine_lines.explanation_en: We use have/has to describe how people look. Use has with he, she, it and one person. Use have with I, you, we and they.

examples.sentence: You and Ashley have brown eyes.

fine_lines.title: is tall vs has blue eyes
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نستخدم is/are مع الصفة وحدها (طويل، قصير). ونستخدم have/has مع صفة + اسم (عيون زرقاء، شعر مجعّد).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use be with an adjective alone (tall, short). Use have with an adjective + noun (blue eyes, curly hair).

fine_lines.title: fun vs funny
fine_lines.explanation_ar: fun يعني ممتعًا ونستمتع به. funny يعني مضحكًا ويجعلنا نضحك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Fun means enjoyable. Funny means it makes you laugh.

expressions.phrase: The weather is beautiful, isn't it?
expressions.meaning_en: A friendly way to talk about the weather and ask someone to agree.
expressions.example: It's a nice day, isn't it?

expressions.meaning_en: Please come and be with us.
expressions.example: We are having tea. Come and join us!

expressions.meaning_en: A happy answer to 'How are you?'
expressions.example: How are you? - I'm doing great, thanks!
Have a seat. I'll get you some water.

expressions.meaning_en: A question asking someone to describe a person's appearance.
expressions.example: What does your brother look like? - He is tall with short hair.

expressions.meaning_en: A yes/no question about someone's appearance.
expressions.example: Does your father wear glasses? - Yes, he does.
I'm busy now. Call me later.

expressions.meaning_en: An informal way to say goodbye.
expressions.example: Bye, Sam! Talk to you later!

expressions.meaning_en: You say this when you find something.
expressions.example: Where is my pen? Oh, here it is.

expressions.meaning_en: You have time; you can go slowly.
expressions.example: No need to hurry. The class starts at ten.

expressions.phrase: It's time to return to work.
expressions.meaning_en: Now we must go back to work.
expressions.example: Lunch is over. It's time to return to work.

grammar.title: Describing people with be and have
grammar.explanation_ar: لوصف شكل شخص: 1) be + صفة: She is tall. / They are short. 2) have/has + صفة + اسم: He has brown eyes. / I have curly hair. 3) للسؤال عن الشكل نقول: What does he/she look like? والجواب يكون بالوصف.
grammar.explanation_en: To describe how a person looks: 1) be + adjective: She is tall. They are short. 2) have/has + adjective + noun: He has brown eyes. I have curly hair. 3) To ask, say: What does he/she look like?
examples: What does your teacher look like? - She is short and she wears glasses.

grammar.title: Order of adjectives before hair
grammar.explanation_ar: عند استخدام أكثر من صفة للشعر نضع الطول أو الشكل ثم اللون: long straight hair, short curly dark hair. ونفصل أحيانًا بفاصلة: straight, light hair. الصفة تأتي قبل الاسم في الإنجليزية، عكس العربية.
grammar.explanation_en: In English, adjectives come before the noun. With hair, length and shape usually come before color: long straight hair, short curly dark hair. Sometimes we use a comma: straight, light hair.
examples: My cousin has long curly hair.

grammar.title: Tag questions: isn't it?
grammar.explanation_ar: نضيف سؤالًا قصيرًا في آخر الجملة لنطلب الموافقة: الجملة مثبتة + سؤال منفي. It is beautiful, isn't it? والجواب: Yes, it is.
grammar.explanation_en: Add a short question at the end of a sentence to ask someone to agree: positive sentence + negative tag. It's beautiful, isn't it? Answer: Yes, it is.
examples: The weather is beautiful, isn't it?
It's a nice day, isn't it? - Yes, it is.
This park is big, isn't it?

questions.question: What is 'people-watching'?
questions.explanation_en: People-watching means watching the people who pass by.

questions.question: Anna ___ blue eyes.
questions.explanation_en: With she or one person, use has.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: مع الصفة وحدها نستخدم is: Keyana is short.
questions.explanation_en: With an adjective alone, use be: Keyana is short.

questions.question: 'What does your boss look like?' - Which answer is correct?
choices: She is short with light hair.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال عن الشكل، فالجواب وصف: قصيرة بشعر فاتح.
questions.explanation_en: The question asks about appearance, so we describe her.

questions.question: The weather is beautiful, ___?
questions.explanation_ar: الجملة مثبتة بـ is، فالسؤال الذيلي: isn't it?
questions.explanation_en: A positive sentence with is takes the tag isn't it?

questions.question: 'Have a seat' means:
questions.explanation_ar: Have a seat طريقة مهذبة لقول: اجلس.
questions.explanation_en: Have a seat is a polite way to say sit down.

questions.question: People-watching is ___. Anna loves it.
questions.explanation_ar: fun تعني ممتعًا. funny تعني مضحكًا.
questions.explanation_en: Fun means enjoyable; funny means it makes you laugh.

questions.question: Which word is the opposite of 'remember'?
questions.explanation_en: Forget is the opposite of remember.
